notes:
Groundwork for practice management systems other than Open Dental. With Open Dental nothing changes in how the office works.
Settings → Practice management system: a card that says how Diastema reaches the office's system ("Open Dental API, direct").
Settings → People: a "Chart" heading above the new permission, "Enter chart work the practice management system could not take", on for every level.
To the chart: a new page, shown in the menu only when there is something on it: anything the practice management system couldn't take, to enter by hand, with Done and Undo. With Open Dental it stays empty unless a write fails for good.
Settings → Office → Records: how long Diastema keeps its own copies of signed forms, plans and receipts (while the account is open, or 5 to 10 years), and the download of everything, now and for 30 days after the subscription ends.
First setup asks which practice management system the office uses (Open Dental; others come later).
A database update runs once at the first start: it adds the tables for later versions and changes nothing in the office's data.
Includes everything in 0.30.0-beta.1. The plan wording changes and Remove from Open Dental from 0.29.2 are not in this beta yet.
